name: llama-cpp on intel-arc-pro-b70: Qwen3.5-27B gguf-q4-k-m tg128 tok/s (bentech, dual B70+B60 Vulkan row-split 32:24)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Ben Linville/bentech, Apr 16 2026, llama-benchy 0.3.5, 25-run matrix). Arc Pro B70 32GB (BMG-G31) + B60 24GB (BMG-G21); Ryzen 7 7800X3D, 64GB DDR5, B850 PCIe4 x4 M.2 adapters; llama.cpp b1-ff5ef82 Vulkan+SYCL, Intel llm-scaler-vllm:0.14.0-b8.1 Docker (vLLM FP8 pipeline-parallel). pp512/tg128, depth0, 3 runs/test mean, no prefix caching, q8_0 KV, FA on, 8k ctx. Per-request tg, NOT aggregate. Qwen3.5-27B gguf-q4-k-m, dual B70+B60 Vulkan row-split 32:24.
notes: Qwen3.5-27B gguf-q4-k-m on dual B70+B60 Vulkan row-split 32:24: pp512 153.0 / tg128 4.9 tok/s. Dual GPU row-split over PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 is SLOWER than single B70 for generation; value is context capacity not speed.
